rationale: Computed frequency droop response P = (nominal_freq - measured_freq) × freq_droop_gain, clipped by charge/discharge limits. Computed voltage droop response Q = (target_voltage - measured_voltage) × voltage_droop_gain, clipped by apparent-power capability sqrt(S_rating^2 - P^2). Updated SOC accounting for discharge efficiency (0.94) and charge efficiency (0.96) over 10-second intervals.
